note: SAP_BASIS 751 SP02 (S/4HANA 1610), recorded from the wire measurements of fr0ster/mcp-abap-adt#351 (2026-11-09), not captured by this repository: a fresh class ZCL_AI_ACT_PROBE in $TMP with one public method, saved inactive; each request sent the same single reference (uri, type, name). The issue reports the requests in this order: preauditRequested=true on /activation (ioc:inactiveObjects, nothing activated), preauditRequested=false on /activation/runs (404), preauditRequested=false on /activation (200, empty body, activated). This step: preauditRequested=true on /activation answered 200 with ioc:inactiveObjects of 8 entries and no message; the class stayed inactive. The issue shows the first two entries in full (the class and CLAS/OCN/definitions); it names the other six by type only (CLAS/OCN/implementations, CLAS/OCN/macros, CLAS/OCN/testclasses, CLAS/OSI, CLAS/OSO, CLAS/OSU), so their entries are reconstructed: the includes' uris follow the class include addresses, and the three section entries' uris follow the source/main#type= form the issue shows for a method entry. Their user and package are those of the two entries shown.

request.headersNote: Caller-supplied headers only, as the issue reports them; the issue records no other header.
